def est(d):
  a=d.groupby(['genre','late']).r.agg(['mean','var','size']).unstack()
  diff=a['mean'][True]-a['mean'][False];G=len(diff)
  se=np.sqrt(((a['var'][True]/a['size'][True])+(a['var'][False]/a['size'][False])).sum())/G
  return round(diff.mean(),4),round(se,4),diff.round(3).to_dict()

  print(name,est(d)[:2],len(d))
